synthesis.body: When two skill test dirs are collected by one pytest process, duplicate *test* basenames make pytest error out loudly — easy to diagnose, not worth a lint. The failure worth guarding is the duplicate *subject* module: a sys.path sibling import binds one skill's render.py for both suites and everything passes green. Check both, and say which was found. Exclude conftest.py from the test-basename comparison — one per directory is pytest's design, so counting it reports every multi-directory invocation as a collision for a reason that is false.

title: Guarding the collision that announces itself instead of the one that is silent
